documents: For the Student Account, bring a photo ID, proof of student status and proof of address.
fees: The Student Account has no monthly account fee. Optional international transfers have separate fees.
eligibility: The demo Student Account is available to enrolled students aged 18 or above.
rate: The Student Account pays no interest in this fictional demo.
apply: Apply for the Student Account through the demo online application or visit a CampusBank branch.
documents_zh: 开立学生账户需要带照片身份证件、在读学生证明和地址证明。
fees_zh: 学生账户不收取账户月费。国际转账等可选服务另外收费。
eligibility_zh: 演示学生账户面向年满 18 岁的在读学生。
rate_zh: 虚构学生账户不支付利息。
apply_zh: 可以通过演示网上申请流程开立学生账户，也可以前往 CampusBank 网点办理。

documents: For the Everyday Account, bring a photo ID and proof of address.
fees: The demo Everyday Account costs GBP 3 per month.
eligibility: The demo Everyday Account is available to adults aged 18 or above.
rate: The Everyday Account pays no interest in this fictional demo.
apply: Apply for an Everyday Account online or at a CampusBank branch.
documents_zh: 开立日常账户需要照片身份证件和地址证明。
fees_zh: 演示日常账户每月收费 3 英镑。
eligibility_zh: 演示日常账户面向年满 18 岁的成年人。
rate_zh: 虚构日常账户不支付利息。
apply_zh: 可以在线申请日常账户，也可以到 CampusBank 网点办理。

documents: For the Savings Account, bring a photo ID and proof of address.
fees: The demo Savings Account has no monthly account fee.
eligibility: The demo Savings Account is available to adults aged 18 or above, with an opening deposit of GBP 10.
rate: The fictional Savings Account pays 2% annual interest. This is a demo value, not a real bank rate.
apply: Open a Savings Account through the demo app or at a CampusBank branch.
documents_zh: 开立储蓄账户需要照片身份证件和地址证明。
fees_zh: 演示储蓄账户不收取账户月费。
eligibility_zh: 演示储蓄账户面向年满 18 岁的成年人，最低开户存款为 10 英镑。
rate_zh: 虚构储蓄账户的年利率为 2%。这是演示值，并非真实银行报价。
apply_zh: 可以通过演示应用或前往 CampusBank 网点开立储蓄账户。

documents: A demo Debit Card comes with a qualifying CampusBank account; use the account's required documents.
fees: The demo Debit Card has no annual fee. A replacement card costs GBP 5.
eligibility: The demo Debit Card is available to Student or Everyday Account holders aged 18 or above.
rate: The Debit Card uses account funds and has no credit interest rate.
apply: Request a Debit Card when opening a Student or Everyday Account.
documents_zh: 演示借记卡配套符合条件的 CampusBank 账户，材料要求与该账户一致。
fees_zh: 演示借记卡不收年费，补卡费用为 5 英镑。
eligibility_zh: 演示借记卡适用于年满 18 岁的学生账户或日常账户持有人。
rate_zh: 借记卡使用账户资金，没有信用借款利率。
apply_zh: 开立学生账户或日常账户时可以申请借记卡。

documents: For the demo Credit Card, provide a photo ID, proof of address and proof of income.
fees: The fictional Credit Card has no annual fee; late payments incur a GBP 10 demo fee.
eligibility: The demo Credit Card requires age 18 or above and an affordability review. The assistant cannot approve applications.
rate: The fictional Credit Card has a 19% annual purchase interest rate. This is a demonstration value.
apply: Use the demo Credit Card application form; the bank reviews the application separately.
documents_zh: 申请演示信用卡需要照片身份证件、地址证明和收入证明。
fees_zh: 演示信用卡不收年费；逾期付款会产生 10 英镑的演示费用。
eligibility_zh: 演示信用卡要求年满 18 岁并接受偿还能力审核。本助手不能批准申请。
rate_zh: 虚构信用卡的消费年利率为 19%，仅用于演示。
apply_zh: 请使用演示信用卡申请表，由银行另行审核申请。

documents: For the demo Personal Loan, provide a photo ID, proof of address and proof of income.
fees: The demo Personal Loan has no application fee. Consult the loan agreement for other charges.
eligibility: The demo Personal Loan requires age 18 or above and an affordability review; eligibility is not approval.
rate: The fictional Personal Loan has a fixed 8% annual interest rate. This is a demo value.
apply: Apply for the Personal Loan online or request an appointment at a CampusBank branch.
documents_zh: 演示个人贷款需要照片身份证件、地址证明和收入证明。
fees_zh: 演示个人贷款不收申请费。其他费用以贷款协议为准。
eligibility_zh: 演示个人贷款要求申请人年满 18 岁，并接受偿还能力审核。符合条件不等于获批。
rate_zh: 虚构个人贷款的固定年利率为 8%，仅用于演示。
apply_zh: 可以在线申请演示个人贷款，也可以预约 CampusBank 网点。
